[[File:Heal Group icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Heal Group''' reduces the caster's current [[hitpoints]] by 75% and heals up to five injured players that are standing within 1 square from the casting player (including players standing on the same spot as the caster) for the amount lost plus 5 hitpoints, split evenly across the nearby injured players. Players must have [[Accept Aid]] turned on to receive healing from this spell. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell.

It is not possible to die from using this spell, as it will not work if the player has less than 11% health. This spell is able to heal other players in [[Monster killing|PvM]] [[single-way combat]]. It does not work, however, in single-way [[Player killing|PvP]].

|change =

* Once the spell has been cast, it will update the player's attack delay by three cycles (akin to eating food).
* The spell now has a 90 second cooldown once cast.
